purpose: Visual validation of detections newly accepted below the common 0.90 baseline

classification_rule.valid: The green box contains a visible face with sufficient structure for gaze processing.
classification_rule.unsafe: The green box contains the real face, but it is severely blurred, departing, or substantially occluded.
classification_rule.false: The green box contains no real face.

retinaface.reason: Lowering from 0.90 adds only one heavily hand-occluded face and no useful face.

yunet.reason: A 0.89 threshold recovers the two useful tilted faces while excluding the five lower-scored occluded or blurred additions.

mediapipe.reason: The 0.85 threshold recovers useful lower-scored faces while excluding the two severely blurred additions below 0.85.

scrfd.reason: All 247 boxes contain the real face. The eight unsafe crops are blur or occlusion cases rather than false face detections and require a downstream gaze-usability guard.

overall_finding: Detector confidence values are not calibrated across model families. Separate thresholds are required. No reviewed candidate produced a non-face false positive in the controlled recording.
